gaps.sentence: Hardly had we sat down ___ the lights went out.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly … when' is the fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: We ran out ___ petrol on the motorway.
gaps.explanation: 'run out OF something' = have none left.

gaps.sentence: He's the man ___ car was stolen.
gaps.explanation: 'whose' shows possession: the man whose car…

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.
Present perfect continuous for duration up to now: has been watching.
